Game Overview

In Hidden Objects Lost Island 2, the core idea is straightforward: embark on an adventurous quest through lush tropical jungles to uncover a forgotten temple. Explore handcrafted scenes teeming with hidden objects and intriguing puzzles. Solve mysteries alongside a charismatic explorer and unveil secrets of the ancient civilization lurking beneath the overgrown canopy. Discover surprises at every turn!
